hypercode.description: HyperCode workspace sessions and sidebar workflows for VS Code
hypercode.setting.showThinking: Show thinking blocks in the session panel.
hypercode.setting.showInternals: Show internal transcript blocks in the session panel.
hypercode.setting.diffMode: Choose how diffs are shown in the session panel.
hypercode.setting.compactSkillInvocation: Render skill invocations in a compact style inside the session panel.
hypercode.setting.showSkillsInSlashAutoc: Show skills directly in slash autocomplete instead of routing through a separate picker.
hypercode.setting.panelTheme: Choose the session panel visual preset.
hypercode.setting.panelColorScheme: Choose the color scheme for the session panel.
hypercode.setting.httpProxy: HTTP proxy passed to the HyperCode runtime. Leave empty to inherit environment variables or fall back to VS Code's http.proxy.
hypercode.setting.cliPath: Absolute path to the HyperCode CLI executable. Leave empty to auto-detect hypercode or compatible fallback commands from PATH.
